method: Independent cross-check of the board's pick direction against HLTV.org's own public betting-analytics pages. HLTV states, in its own words, which team 'is the bookmaker favorite with the best odds'. This is used ONLY as a directional cross-check (favourite vs board pick); it is not a price input and no number is copied from it. Each row keeps the exact URL that was read.

rows.hltv_statement: Galorys is the bookmaker favorite with the best odds (analytics list page)
rows.contradiction_note: The same source's per-match page https://www.hltv.org/betting/analytics/2399204/ex-keyd-stars-vs-galorys-esl-challenger-league-season-52-south-america-cup-3 states the opposite: 'ex-Keyd Stars is the bookmaker favorite with the best odds'. HLTV contradicts itself between its list page and its per-match page for this fixture; the board follows the external prices (Galorys favourite at Pinnacle/Bovada/egamersworld), which agree with the list page. Published as a flagged irregularity.
